content.text:
Perfect! All 50 tests pass, including the 13 new tests for addLine and removeLine.

**Added to src/errors.js:**
- `LINE_NOT_FOUND` — when removing a SKU that doesn't exist on the invoice
- `NOT_DRAFT` — when trying to modify an invoice that's not in draft status

**Added to src/invoices.js:**
- `addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })` — adds a new line or increases qty if SKU already exists
  - Validates qty is a positive integer (QTY_INVALID)
  - Validates SKU exists (UNKNOWN_SKU)
  - Only works on draft invoices (NOT_DRAFT)
  - Never mutates input

- `removeLine(invoice, sku)` — removes a line by SKU
  - Returns LINE_NOT_FOUND if SKU isn't on invoice
  - Returns NO_LINES if it's the last line
  - Only works on draft invoices (NOT_DRAFT)
  - Never mutates input

**Added 13 tests covering:**
- Adding new lines and increasing quantities
- All error conditions (UNKNOWN_SKU, QTY_INVALID, NOT_DRAFT, LINE_NOT_FOUND, NO_LINES)
- Input immutability
- Chaining multiple operations (add → remove → add, etc.)
